notes.title: September 1st Update
notes.content:
Hi there, starting September on the right foot hopefully.

[list]
[*] Quest rework:
	[list]
        [*]You now get more experience per quest.
	[*]Quests per town level are reduced to +1 from +3.
	[*]The quest's name includes the level and experience to be gained. 
	[*]Marked quests are closer to the stairs,
	[*]Caravan encounter now awards a marked quest instead of teleport 2 squares.
	[*]Main quests will always be on top of the list. 
[/list]
[*]Pet classes level 55 Perk now provides 10% mastery to all as well as All Charm.
[*]Tactician now increases chance of pet to get hit instead of you. You start at 50% + X% of tactician.
[*]Fixed not properly scrolling down in combat.
[*]There is now a confirmation when selling a pet.
[*]Sleep costs the same regardless of level, it already has a harsh penalty.
[*]Fixed melee damage display when damage is zero.
[*]Dragons now burn you properly (animation fix).
[*]Imps took less vitamins and are now smaller.
[*]Reduced the size of the combats buttons.
[*]Undead stamina drain is reduced by 3/4.
[*]Now important items will drop at all floors after they first start dropping. (Skill potions, Rations, keys, etc.)
[*]Monsters now drop less gold.
[*]Items and equipment sells for 1/3 of the original cost instead of 1/2.
[/list]

Thanks and happy scavenging,
Vidama Software

notes.title: DLC Inferno is released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are excited to release the mayor content update DLC Inferno. Take the fight to the Demon realm!

Lots of updates, so we will give you the highlights, the rest you will find out in the game.

Base Game:
[/list]
[*] Holy now reduces enemy positive buffs. 
[*] Stone now causes weakness.
[*] Shadow now reduces maximum life.
[*] Classes statistics were changed to reflect balance and new spell use.
[*] All controls are now Joystick and Keyboard accessible. No mouse needed.
[*] Speed increase for initial loading and overall game experience.
[list]

Expansion:
[/list]
[*] New Perks! New tab in Stats to use the experience to buy cool perks.
[*] There is a new capstone Perk for classes that include Master: You can have Demons as pets.
[*] Each class now has access to a dungeon perk to start at level 1. Barbarians do not use stamina and sorcerers move by teleport only.
[*] 10 more levels to explore, take on the demons themselves. 
[*] A new Ring slot. All equipment now can have a buff such as Protection: Casts X Armor enhancement on you at start of combat.
[*] Unlimited equipment! With 241 equipment, 33 buffs and 9 spell types, there are 71,577 unique equipment in the game.
[*] Now the Minions level up with you. Terrorize the depths with a overgrown bunny!
[*] New demon realm with over 150 new monsters with with new abilities, including multiple resistances that include physical immunity.. A dangerous boss that commands the demon invasion needs to be defeated.
[*] New items for all levels. Including an item that combines 3 same kind equipment into a higher tier.
[*] Lots more to find.
[/list]

Happy scavenging!

Ilmar 
Vidama Software

Hi there, 

There will be bug fixes of course! 

We waited a bit before announcing to check on the last update for stability to be sure.

New content updates will now be as a DLC.  

To everyone that bought the game:

Thanks for sticking out with the bugs, the content updates, the highs and lows. We would have never finish this product without your input and support.

To those purchasing the game now:

This is a labor of love and hardship against everything going against you as a small developer. Hopefully you enjoy the adventure as we do.

See you you all in the next project!

Thanks for all the fish!

Ilmar
Vidama Software.

notes.title: New Class: Warlock
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34904792/3c86b644389a1c29eb0693cdc53e3c82f3671eac.png[/img]

Here is the new update list:
[list]
[*] Added New Class Warlock: Uses dots and harvest to clear the depths.
[*] Skills: Burn, Decay, Harvest, Purge, Corruption.
[*] New achievements for IronMan win with all the classes.
[*] Equipment skill changes now grow per level, instead of statically. Unique equipment now have 10% more damage.

[*] Added a new way to check for monster strength. Is more rewarding for higher difficulties. Now it compares your strength to monster strength. Then you can fall into Minimal (Grey), Lower(Blue), Normal(Black), Higher(Yellow) or Maximum(Red) loot and exp from the fight.
[*] You will get a message about it as soon the fight start.
[*] Fixing the Escape and Loot key bug. 
[*] Thorns and Reflect on yourself now affect your pet too. Reflect is increased in strength.
[*] Finishing several quest with same hunt objective should work properly.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34904792/2478321e869406385b4025f4784775699d23eb3f.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 1.13 New Ironman Mode
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34904792/95e8fa7a9d01649fbb5bb97e6a6703f6966a5454.png[/img]

General Changes:
[*] Added new Ironman Mode: 75% Increase, 150% score increase. Can't use Bank. If you die once, you switch to Impossible. 
[*] The levels have more parity, Easy, Normal and Hard are a bit harder.
[*] XP can be used as a resource in the academy. After max level will still accumulate.
[*] A new place in town called Academy, you can use XP to get extra rewards. It doesn't affect your guild level if you spend it.
[*] Skill potions will be for sale at 2k exp each there.
[*] Mage enhancements are now ==> Focus, Drain, Dispell, Purge, Master (Focus+Drain)
[*] Necro enhancements are now ==> Charm Undead, Mark, Drain, Lifesteal, Penance (Mark+Drain)
[*] Sorcerer enhancements are now ==> Mark, Focus, Regeneration, Purge, Overwhelm (Mark+Focus)
[*] New Master Combat status, adds Focus to you, Drain to enemy.
[*] You now get an additional perk per town level, +1 carry item. Nice to carry more Full Life Potions.
[*] Added new font color settings tab to help with Color Blindness or just in general to change combat colors.
[*] You can now buy while in town using funds from the bank.
[*] Now the screen flashes red on each step that you are losing life instead of stamina.
[*] The dungeon button in town will now display the Warp Crystal interface if you ever been to level 2 at least. If you do not have a Crystal, it will display the price on each level and can be used right away.
[*] Three new Food items added: Cave Mushrooms, Cooked Meal, Feast. They increase maximum HP by 10, 20 and 30%.
[*] Lake event changed: Now is 35% chance to find the Mermaid, offers 50% life buff, and more exp. In case of failure, you gain Cave Mushroom effect, 10% life buff.
[*] Architect now teleports to a random location instead of entrance.
[*] The Altar event inventory sacrifice does not award exp anymore.
[*] The Wanderer event is removed from game.
[*] The Small Brown Ghost reign of terror is over, he is slightly more easier.
[*] Rabbits now use special status in melee and use steal as an enhancement. Red Rabbits now cause Feblemind instead of Enrage.
[*] Minor map bug fixes and overall map speed enhancements.
Thanks,

Ilmar
Vidama Software

notes.title: Update 0.83d
notes.content:
Hello, here are some changes.

[*] Combat dynamics have slightly changed.
Critical Hit hits once for 150% damage. Enemy defends with its regular armor. Same for Critical Cast but with resistance instead.
Double Hit hits twice for a total of 180% damage. Enemy defends with 180% armor.  Same for Double Cast but with resistance instead.
Execute hits twice for a total of 270% damage. Enemy defends with 180% armor. Same for Cataclysm but with resistance instead.
Critical now is more useful against heavy armor/resistance enemies or if you are weakened/feebleminded.
Double excels at low armor/resistance enemies or if you increase your strength/magical damage.
[*] Since multiplier damage increased, some guilds passive damage skill gains were changed to defense skills instead.
[*] Melee and Magic damage/armor increase amulets are reduced by 50%.
[*] Monsters now scale slightly faster.
[*] Pet companions now have 75% life of captured monsters instead of 100%.
[*] Graphics improvement on some monsters.
[*] Reduced enemy damage animation to once per turn, no more head bobbing.
[*] Bug Fix: Enemies not casting enhancements.
[*] Necklace is now proper rarity for the level.
[*] More bats are now animals.

Happy scavenging,

Vidama Software

notes.title: Update 0.81b New Pet Class added: The Hunter.
notes.content:
Version .81b is out! New class added, check it out.

[list] 
[*] Easy mode does not increase HP by 25% and hard mode does not reduce it by 25%. If your character had more health than current maximum, it will update to the new maximum.
[*] Hammers get +10% to Double Hit now.
[*] Rest of the weapons get +10% to Dual Strike to compensate.
[*] Spells increase per level reduced to 4 from 5;
[*] Class added: The Hunter class, using bows and daggers and the ability to charm animals.
[*] Info added: Now you can see the type of monster when viewing the info of the monster in combat.
[*] Pets added: Now you have a pet while in dungeon and even town. The life of the pet is displayed on the screen at all times.
[*] Getting a pet: Hunters can use their first level buff Charm Animal on animal type monsters. Other classes need to use the new item Charm Animal Scroll.
[*] Pet combat: If you have a pet, it will now appear next to you in combat. It will either cast a spell or melee each turn. Pets inflict combat statuses and can stack with yours. They will benefit of debuffs on the enemy.
[*] Pet life: Enemies have a 50% chance of targeting the pet instead of you. Pets are immune to status on themselves. When the life reaches 0, they die and are lost forever.
[*] Pet heal: You can now buy a new item in town, Water, which will heal your pet completely. It will not revive dead pets.
[*] New combat enhancements: Penance, Corrosion, Prickle, etc.
[*] Mage changes: Mage buffs have changed to Mark, Drain, Dispel, Resistance and Penance. Penance will lower magic resistance and heal you for each spell cast.
[*] Enhancements that reduce or augment damage are reduced by 33%. This includes regeneration, armor, weakness, enrage, focus, etc.
[*] Defense skills now improve defense by 200% instead of 300%. Cover is now called Guard.
[*] Monster scale faster now, beware of the lower levels.
[*] Hunter starts with Plain String Amulet.
[*] Traps skill doubled in effectiveness.
[*] Fixed bug when not completing Great Ape on main quest, now it checks if you ever killed one whenever. Same to Blue Dragon encounter.
[*] If taming a new companion while still having one, you will replace the current one by the end of the battle.
[*] Close Encounter now rewards gold instead of random equipment.
[*] Mounted warrior now rewards a healthy XP bonus instead of crystals.
[*] Bug fix: Mysterious Altar was displaying the wrong XP amount. It was still awarding the correct one.
[*] Bug with music in event fights fixed.
[*] Level up screen was fixed.
[*] Many descriptions and tool tips were changed in preparation for localization to other languages and to be clearer.
[*] Events provide less XP and more gold.
[*] Many other bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1774196868

Thanks and keep scavenging.

Ilmar
Vidama Software

notes.title: Update 0.8
notes.content:
Version .8 is out now. Check it out and let us know in the forums how are the changes.

[list] 
[*] It improves speed by a large margin, almost did not need a loading screen anymore.
[*] Screens and text look more spiffy now in larger resolutions.
[*] Due to popular demand: The map is now unique to each character, it does not change ever. Events and Inn just refresh the monsters and events in map. Additionally, it does not go unexplored. You found it, you keep it open in your map.
[*] The glow around equipment now represents the rarity, the element will be displayed next to the item portrait and in the name.
[*] Seeker now enchants equipment for a price, but it assigns a random enchant.
[*] You can now use potions before combat, so pop that Medium Shield Potion to gain an edge on an oncoming battle.
[*] The monster compendium in the help will now include all monster found in any character.
[*] The Heavy Crystal now permanently removes the walls surrounding you when used.
[*] The buffs and debuffs that reduce incoming damage (Armor, Weakness, Regeneration, etc) were reduced to balance them against other options.
[*] Many events changed and item functionality is bit different.
[*] Many bug fixes, from final boss to minor ones such as events not working.
[*] Added a new title song.
[/list]

Thanks and keep scavenging.

Ilmar
Vidama Software

notes.title: Future Plans
notes.content:
Hey all,

Now that things have calmed down, let me share our future plans and goals with you.

We plan, until release time, to:
[list] 
[*]Add 2 more classes, both of which will be able to use pets. One is the Hunter and another one is the Necromancer. They also will have a different way to succeed in battle.
[*]Double the amount of fight locations. Additionally, we will add effects for each location that can add to battle strategy. For example, in the lava room, you and the monster start with a Burn debuff in place.
[*] Add new regular and quest type events.
[*] Add a new undead monster group (currently in progress) such as skeletons and ghouls. The delay is due to how they might interact with the Necromancer class.
[*]Update the transition between screens, hopefully avoiding too much loading time.
[*]Add more languages and platforms for release.
[*]Squash the bugs that show up.
[/list]

Be part of the experience and give us suggestions on the forum!

Thanks, and let's keep scavenging!
Ilmar
Vidama Software

notes.title: Thanks!
notes.content:
Thanks to all that have purchased and supported this game so far. 

As an small developer company creating a game that you are passionate about, it can be challenging to stay on top of every single detail. But your encouragement and support makes it possible to get the extra energy to keep going.

This few days we have been trying to get all the launch bugs squashed, and still working on it. Some points that have been brought up:

- The bug reporting tool can for sure use an improvement. For now, if you want a reply, please include your steam user name in the submission. It does send out information about the recent crash or exception.
- Some issues with specific computer setups will require to rework part of the UI. We are working diligently on that.
- On that topic, I will set up a Beta branch that will contain the next UI upgrade to fix these problems. You are welcome to use it at any time once is been set up.

Thanks again!

Ilmar
Vidama Software

PS. The beer quantity issue was fixed, can always use more beer!
